reference reading and rule stress cases; no keyword-generated labels

examples.reference: check for this mail in my contact if not then add it
examples.observation: Checking is explicitly requested and addition is conditionally directed; no execution-state truth is supplied.

examples.reference: could you please check if i am free on thursday afternoon if so add a reminder to go to the food festival
examples.observation: Check availability and, if available, add a reminder are separately expressed; native calendar_set cannot erase the query.

examples.reference: if my vacuum cleaner is not activated please activate it
examples.observation: Explicit conditional activation of the vacuum; the utterance does not establish current device state.

examples.reference: if it is noon in virginia what time is it in california
examples.observation: The noon condition supplies a time-conversion hypothetical, not a request to set a clock.

examples.reference: if it is raining i will not go for job
examples.observation: A statement about the speaker not going to work under rain does not by itself request the assistant to execute an operation.

examples.reference: send an email to mom asking if she was able to order the book from amazon that i told her about
examples.observation: The question about ordering a book is message content for mom; do not infer a request for the assistant to order it.

examples.reference: please increase the volume of the music hips don't lie
examples.observation: The negative words in the music title do not negate the explicitly requested volume increase.

examples.reference: could you play you don't bring me flowers
examples.observation: Do not bring me flowers occurs inside requested music content; no ban on playback is expressed.
A prohibition on speaking may satisfy a silence/mute definition, not a request to speak.

examples.reference: don't let me forget rover's vet appointment on the twenty fifth
examples.observation: Do not let me forget is a reminder construction; lexical negation alone does not reverse the requested reminder.
Opening a train-ticket app does not itself express ticket purchase or a specified transport information request.

examples.reference: book a ticket for me on a train to get to boston tomorrow what is available
examples.observation: Booking plus what is available expresses both operation and information requests; native ticket is not a semantic exclusivity rule.

examples.reference: please add to my contact lists and send them a reminder email
examples.observation: Adding contacts and sending a reminder do not explicitly request looking up a contact.

examples.reference: is there a way to pull up information about a contact
examples.observation: Asking whether a lookup method exists is distinguished from requesting an actual lookup; conventional indirect requests need pragmatic review.

scope: Rule observations only; not intent labels or independent semantic review.
